title: Stock Trading Now Counts Toward Your Binance VIP Qualification for A Limited Time
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Terms and conditions apply.  Fellow Binancians, Binance VIP is introducing a 3x volume multiplier for stock trading promotion for a limited time. Every dollar you trade in stocks counts as $3 toward your VIP spot volume threshold — giving regular users and VIP 1 - 2 users a faster route to their next VIP tier. During the Eligible Period, eligible  users’ stock trading volume on Binance is automatically counted toward their 30-day spot volume total at 3x the traded value. No registration required. Example : User A trades $500,000 in stocks and it will count as $1,500,000 toward their 30-day spot volume total. That is enough to meet the VIP 1 threshold ($1,000,000) with room to spare, or make meaningful progress toward VIP 2 ($5,000,000). Program Details Detail Infoformation Eligible Users Regular users and VIP 1 - 2 users Multiplier 3x on all stock trading volume Counts toward 30-day spot volume for VIP tier qualification Eligible Products All stock trading on Binance Eligible Period 2026-06-18 00:00 (UTC) - 2026-07-18 23:59 (UTC) Registration None required VIP Spot Volume Requirements (for reference) Tier 30-Day Spot Volume Required VIP 1 ≥ $1,000,000 VIP 2 ≥ $5,000,000 VIP status is also subject to BNB holding requirements. See  full VIP criteria for details . How It Works: Trade any stocks available on Binance during the Eligible Period. Your stock trading volume is automatically converted at 3X and added to your 30-day spot volume total. The maximum VIP upgrade is capped at VIP 3 with the multiplier. Users who have reached VIP 3 or higher will not receive the 3x multiplier boost, but their stock trading volume will continue to be included in the 30-day spot volume calculation. No opt-in or registration required. VIP levels are updated daily at 08:00 (UTC) based on the applicable requirements  Explore More Stocks Trading on Binance: 7,000+ U.S.-listed stocks and ETFs , including the world's most recognized companies and funds. One account  for both crypto and stocks, no platform-switching required. Fractional shares from $5 , so you can start small and build over time. Trade 24/5  with flexibility to react across time zones. Zero commission  plus a minimum platform fee of $0.17 per order. (Promotion Until 2026-06-30 23:59 (UTC)) Pay with stablecoins or BNB  directly from your Binance balance. VIP Eligibility and Access: Become a Binance VIP and get access to a range of VIP-only benefits, including lower fees, higher limits, priority support, advanced insights, VIP swag, event invitations, and more. VIP levels are updated daily at 08:00 (UTC) based on the applicable requirements. If you qualify under multiple criteria, your VIP level will reflect the highest level you meet. The 3x multiplier applies to all stock trading volume on Binance and is counted toward 30-day spot volume for VIP tier qualification purposes only. VIP tier upgrades remain subject to all standard VIP criteria including BNB holding requirements. Fees are subject to change. We will provide advance notice of any changes to this fee schedule.
